sections.title: Zeilberger meets Jones
sections.extract: Zeilberger meets Jones The colored Jones function of a framed knot K in 3–space JK : N −→Z[q±1/4] is a sequence of Laurent polynomials that essentially measures the Jones poly- nomial of a knot and its cables. This is a powerful but not well understood invariant of knots. As an example, the colored Jones function of the 0–framed right-hand trefoil is given by JK(n) = q1/2−n/2 1 −q−1 n−1 X k=0 q−kn(1 −q−n)(1 −q1−n) .
